decisions.question: Can sustained-running activation contrasts yield useful causal speed, effort, or posture control?
decisions.hypothesis: Removing near-stationary recovery windows prevents unwrapped rotation history from dominating the differences. A fitting-only half-median forward-speed floor should retain broad independent running contrasts.
decisions.validation_specification: Same eight nonzero strengths, ten paired validation seeds110000-110009, all15vectors, action-bias controls forshortlist;30confirmation120000-120029and30replication130000-130029, no changed usefulness gates. All seedpartitionsfresh relative001.

decisions.decision: Adopt inference-only buffer_size=1 loader override and audited cache migration before calibration.
decisions.evidence: inference-memory-audit.json: unchanged policy hash and byte-for-byte equality of every saved array for diagnostic seed 100000 and fitting seeds 101000 and 101010. Replay array allocation reduced from 308000000 to 1540 bytes.

decisions.decision: Correct physical episode failure before selection or confirmation: an episode fails if its post-onset inversion or forbidden-contact fraction exceeds 5%, in addition to termination/prefix failure. Preserve pooled fractions and retain the existing maximum five-percentage-point increase in failure. Recompute all cached validation effects under this derived-analysis correction.
